name: Scotiabank Chile S.A.
summary: Scotiabank Chile S.A. provides various financial products and services in Chile. It operates through Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, CAT, Treasury, and Other segments. The company is involved in the intermediation of money and financial instruments represented by securities, commercial paper, or any other credit instrument. It also provides current, saving, and digital foreign currency accounts; term deposit, agreement, mutual fund, and investment products; insurance products, such as cars, home and protection, health, trips, and life; credit, debit, and business cards; and wealth and investment management services.
